question:
Which of the following figures will complete the figural series given below? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cae8a327a6498c106d70ca2bad272e688b39e290596b40142f140c9ef1843e3b.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) In each box two elements at the sides interchange positions. 

2) The center arrow element rotates 90º clockwise subsequently.

3) No change in the rest of the elements. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae98061943ac27c7143c4dcc565844a7ff6b1b709778ea7335144df3532bed67.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9121381c0407b2bdf55dc14f07ffa4ec5510f509d2d29ebacb5b4fc01ca92b81.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
